{{nihongo|'''Anaishi Shrine'''|穴石神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Iga Province]].

[[File:Anaishi Shrine Hōkyōintō.jpg|Thumbnail|Stone Hōkyōintō pagoda of Anaishi Shrine]]
'''Anaishi Shrine''' (あないしじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}} {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=listed shrine}} (minor shrine) located in Ishikawa, {{ill|Iga, Mie|ar|إغا (ميه)|azb|ایقا، میه|be|Іга (горад)|ce|Ига (гӀала)|ceb|Iga-shi|ckb|ئیگا (میێ)|cs|Iga (Mie)|de|Iga (Mie)|eo|Iga|es|Iga (Mie)|et|Iga (linn)|fa|ایگا، میه|fi|Iga (Mie)|fr|Iga (Mie)|gl|Iga|hy|Իգա|id|Iga, Mie|it|Iga (Mie)|ja|伊賀市|ko|이가시|mzn|ایگا، میه|nl|Iga (Mie)|pl|Iga (miasto)|pt|Iga (Mie)|ro|Iga|ru|Ига (город)|sh|Iga|sr|Ига|sv|Iga|szl|Iga (mjasto)|tg|Ига|th|อิงะ|tl|Iga, Mie|tr|Iga, Mie|tt|Ига (шәһәр)|uk|Іґа (Міє)|uz|Iga (Mie)|vi|Iga, Mie|war|Iga, Mie|zh|伊賀市|zh_classical|伊賀市|zh_min_nan|Iga-chhī|zh_yue|伊賀|qid=Q460820}}, {{ill|Mie Prefecture|Q128196|qid=Q128196}}.

=== Explanation ===
Anaishi Shrine, though a local shrine, was promoted in the first year of {{ill|Jōgan|Q1075635|qid=Q1075635|lt=Jōgan}} (859) from having no rank to Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade, and was placed among the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=official shrines}}. This first year of Jōgan was the year when the mythological genealogies found in the {{ill|Kiki (Shinto)|Q842308|qid=Q842308}} were first applied by the {{ill|Imperial Court of Japan|ja|朝廷 (日本)|qid=Q30253177|lt=Imperial Court}}, and 267 shrines nationwide were promoted. “Anaishi” is considered synonymous with “Anashi,” and as a phonetic transcription is said to be related to {{ill|Anashi-Nimasu Hyōzu Shrine|ja|穴師坐兵主神社|qid=Q11597229}}. Various theories have been proposed regarding the enshrined deities of Anaishi Shrine, but according to shrine records they are {{ill|Konohanasakuya-hime|az|Konohanasakuya|ca|Konohana no Sakuya hime|de|Konohanasakuyahime|fa|کونوهاناساکویا-هیمه|fr|Konohana-no-Sakuya|it|Konohanasakuya-hime|ja|コノハナノサクヤビメ|ko|고노하나노사쿠야비메|mni|ꯀꯣꯅꯣꯍꯅꯁꯀꯨꯌ-ꯍꯤꯃꯦ|pl|Konohanasakuya-hime|ru|Коноханасакуя-химэ|sv|Konohanasakuyahime|th|เซ็นเง็ง|vi|Konohana Sakuya Hime|zh|木花開耶姬|qid=Q1781862}} and {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|fr|Ama-no-Koyane-no-mikoto|it|Ame-no-Koyane|ja|天児屋命|mni|ꯑꯃꯦ-ꯅꯣ-ꯀꯣꯌꯅꯦ|pt|Ame-no-Koyane|ru|Амэ-но коянэ-но микото|simple|Ame-no-Koyane|zh|天兒屋命|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}}. Another theory interprets the Anashi deity as a {{ill|Fūjin|azb|فوجین|de|Fūjin|es|Fūjin|fa|فوجین|fi|Fūjin|fr|Fūjin (divinité)|hy|Ֆուջին|id|Fūjin|it|Fūjin|ja|風神|ka|ფუჯინი|mni|ꯐꯨꯖꯤꯟ|pt|Fujin|ru|Фудзин|th|ฟูจิง|tr|Fūjin|uk|Бог вітру (Японія)|vi|Fūjin|zh|風神 (日本)|qid=Q1483957}}, with the meaning of “Anashi” representing the “northwest wind.”

=== Treasures ===
A pair of {{ill|wooden|ja|木造|qid=Q11519384}} {{ill|A-un|el|Α-ουν|it|A-un|ja|阿吽|uk|А-гум|zh|阿吽|qid=Q4647014}} {{ill|Komainu|Q20155846|qid=Q20155846}} (guardian lion-dogs) (height: 54 centimeters) still exist, bearing the following ink inscription:
{{Quotation|Dedicated and carved komainu. Iga Province, Abe District, Ishikawa, Amatsu Shrine Daimyōjin. Before the honored deity, principal supplicant Kawai Gozaburō no Jō, Fujiwara no Sueko Shigetane, likewise Inui Magosaburō (northwest), together with over eighty parishioners. Purpose: complete fulfillment of blessings. Genna 6 (Kōshin), twelfth month, an auspicious day. Made by Ōbe Shi (Great Buddha sculptor) of Sōraku-ji in Gōshū.|Kawai Shigetane, Inui Magosaburō|From the ink inscription on the komainu}}
:This is an excellent early {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963|lt=Edo-period}} work jointly dedicated by residents of {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kawai-gō}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kawai Shigetane}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Inui Magosaburō}}, and over 80 parishioners.
:Together with the stone Hōkyōintō pagoda, it is designated as a {{ill|Iga, Mie|ar|إغا (ميه)|azb|ایقا، میه|be|Іга (горад)|ce|Ига (гӀала)|ceb|Iga-shi|ckb|ئیگا (میێ)|cs|Iga (Mie)|de|Iga (Mie)|eo|Iga|es|Iga (Mie)|et|Iga (linn)|fa|ایگا، میه|fi|Iga (Mie)|fr|Iga (Mie)|gl|Iga|hy|Իգա|id|Iga, Mie|it|Iga (Mie)|ja|伊賀市|ko|이가시|mzn|ایگا، میه|nl|Iga (Mie)|pl|Iga (miasto)|pt|Iga (Mie)|ro|Iga|ru|Ига (город)|sh|Iga|sr|Ига|sv|Iga|szl|Iga (mjasto)|tg|Ига|th|อิงะ|tl|Iga, Mie|tr|Iga, Mie|tt|Ига (шәһәр)|uk|Іґа (Міє)|uz|Iga (Mie)|vi|Iga, Mie|war|Iga, Mie|zh|伊賀市|zh_classical|伊賀市|zh_min_nan|Iga-chhī|zh_yue|伊賀|qid=Q460820}} {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=designated cultural property}} (sculpture).
